purpose: Pre-registration lock for the five new reconciliation scenario families. Hashed BEFORE the first run so an expectation cannot be adjusted to match a result already seen.
notSelfHealing: This lock is NOT written by any generator. It is tracked, and scenariosFreeze.test.ts recomputes the digest and fails on any drift. A freeze record a generator rewrites cannot detect the one thing it exists to detect.
revisionRule: If the product is found defective against these expectations, fix the PRODUCT and re-run against this same lock. If an expectation is later proven objectively wrong, that is a governed revision with explicit evidence and a NEW lock - never a silent edit, and never one that improves a result.
